scope: Repository Go under cmd/ and internal/, excluding tests and this scanner; jobs SQL passed through ordinary call arguments with package/local string constants, concatenation and fmt.Sprintf resolution.
Explicit Go conditions/switches naming models.JobStatus, the exact JobStatus validation receiver, or a jobStatus variable; historical migrations in both directions.
One source-ordered SQL/Go site per function with whole-query/token fingerprint; mixed-policy entries retain explicit per-fact classifications. No runtime/schema changes are approved by matching.
limitations: Conservative lexical SQL binding/scopes, not a PostgreSQL parser, whole-program Go type checker, runtime query coverage proof or dynamic SQL completeness proof.

Ordinary direct/schema-qualified jobs tables, aliases, lexical SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE/CTE scopes and the explicit j.status AS job_status projection are recognized. Arbitrary renamed columns, SQL functions/views, procedural dollar quotes, generated files, runtime table names, reflection, interface/alias flow and imported/parameterized SQL helpers are not proved.

Unresolved string portions remain <dynamic>; available jobs/status facts are still review candidates. Raw/untyped Go status variables other than the explicit jobStatus spelling and helper-derived enum aliases require manual source audit.

Source fingerprints retain full normalized SQL tokens including joins, negation and eligibility; comments/spacing outside SQL literals are ignored. A newly inserted source-ordered site can require downstream ordinal review; matching never establishes actual 0a predicates, locks, schema/index compatibility, or physical drain.

Only lifecycle-owned request-consumer job types may gain awaiting_start_control in 0a. Unrelated domain jobs and physical runnable/running/terminal predicates are deliberately not widened. Re-audit all dynamic and newly introduced query forms before activation.

Every SupersedeUnlaunchedIntentInTx action below requires canonical SupersessionAuthority and positive fenced no-launch proof over every immutable allocation/continuation receipt for that binding. Unknown or possible acceptance routes to ReconcileSupersededIntent, never unsent closure; physical drain blockers remain independently retained. EndSession remains idle-only and exposes Abandon rather than broadening eligibility.
